examples.arabic: قالي صارلنا ساعة بالمكتبة عم ندرس لمشروعنا فيك تجي
examples.english: He told me "We've been in the library for an hour studying for our project, can you come?"
examples.transliteration: Qalli "Saarlana saa'a bil maktabeh 3am nodros li-mashruu3na, feek teji?"

examples.arabic: حملت حقيبتها وتوجهت نحو مكتبة الجامعة، عازمة على فهم تعقيدات السياسة اللبنانية.
examples.english: She carried her bag and headed towards the university library, determined to understand the complexities of Lebanese politics.
examples.transliteration: Ḥamalat ḥaqībatahā wa tawajjahat naḥwa maktabat al-jāmi'a, 'āzima 'ala fahm ta'qīdāt as-siyāsa al-lubnāniyya.
examples.storyTitle: The Stalled Law at Hamra Cafe
